courses.title: Business Strategy for Technology Leaders
courses.description: Business Strategy for Technology Leaders focuses on business strategy for people working toward a IT Head role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces business partnership, enough to apply alongside business strategy in real IT Head work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to business strategy and show how business partnership supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying business strategy to a real IT Head scenario
Practicing business strategy through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to business partnership
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Technology Governance in Practice
courses.description: Technology Governance in Practice is a focused course on technology governance for people already working toward a IT Head role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying technology governance on your own.

courses.title: Vendor Management Fundamentals
courses.description: Vendor Management Fundamentals walks you through the basics of vendor management, built for people new to IT Head work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of vendor management, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.

alternates.title: Business Strategy Essentials
alternates.description: Business Strategy Essentials is a short introduction to business strategy for people moving toward a IT Head role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show business strategy in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if business strategy is new to you.
